title: Earth and the Moon, Drawn to True Scale | Space Atlas
description: Unlike the full solar system, the Earth-Moon system is small enough to show size AND distance accurately at once. See just how much empty space is really between them.
ogTitle: Earth and the Moon, Drawn to True Scale
ogDescription: Both size and distance, accurate at the same time — every other planet in the solar system would fit in the gap between Earth and the Moon.
jsonldName: Earth and the Moon, Drawn to True Scale
jsonldDescription: A true-to-scale diagram of the Earth-Moon system showing both relative size and relative distance accurately at the same time.
